description:
## Problem
On the remove-deprecated-spellings branch (item core-exec-remove-deprecated-aliases), constructors, get_adapter, PlatformRegistry.create_adapter, the CLI, saved configuration and MCP reject removed spellings, but calling an adapter's from_config directly does not. Verified 2026-11-24: SnowflakeAdapter.from_config({..., 'warehouse': 'OLD_WH'}) succeeds and the adapter uses the default warehouse COMPUTE_WH; RedshiftAdapter.from_config({..., 'cluster_identifier': 'c'}) succeeds and drops the value. A Python user upgrading to 0.6.0 would silently run on, and be billed for, a different warehouse or cluster.

## Change
There is no shared concrete from_config: PlatformAdapter.from_config is abstract (benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py), and build_adapter_config (benchbox/platforms/base/config_utils.py) is shared but about 30 adapters bypass it (for example bigquery.py, duckdb.py, postgresql.py, databricks/adapter.py). Reuse reject_removed_adapter_keywords (benchbox/core/removed_options.py) at a point every adapter's from_config passes through (for example a wrapper applied in the registry or a base-class hook), raising the same TypeError as the constructors, for every adapter in the registry. Prefer landing this on the remove-deprecated-spellings branch before its PR merges; if that PR has merged, ship it as a follow-up before 0.6.0rc1.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create), never the primary clone; heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points; never set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK or force admission; stage explicit paths; add a changelog.d fragment if users can see the change; no explanatory comments (make comment-policy-check).
